title: Rack and pinion
about: an 18-tooth pinion with a crank driving a 100 mm rack along a rail, with slider and revolute joints and an interference check
tries: Add end stops so the rack cannot leave the pinion | Make the rack twice as long and print it in two pieces joined by a dovetail | Explain why the peg sits 7.5 pitches along the rack

agent.role: a mechanism designer who builds linear drives from racks and pinions
agent.prompt: Prefer j.lib.gear.rack and j.inspect.gearMesh for every distance; check poses with the joints and .interference(); never move the rack without turning the pinion by travel / r.

fragments.coupling: Keep travel = pitch radius × angle (in radians) whenever you set both joints.
